youtube_title: The Michigan Dogman: the legend that started as a 1987 radio prank
body: Seven feet tall, a dog's head on a man's body, a howl like a human scream: that's the Michigan Dogman. The legend says lumberjacks first met it in Wexford County in 1887, and that it comes back every ten years, in years ending in 7. Here's the twist: the story comes from a song. On April Fools' Day, 1987, Traverse City radio station WTCM aired 'The Legend', written by disc jockey Steve Cook, who has said he made it up as a prank. Then listeners called the station to say they had seen one. Cook has used the song to raise money for animal charities. And next year is 2027. 👻 Comment your town, and it could be next! #MichiganDogman #Dogman #Michigan #TraverseCity #UrbanLegend #LaPorteAfterDark
